evals.name: add-countdown
evals.prompt: in my coins game i want a 30 second countdown. show it next to the score in the same text (like "Score: 3  Time: 27") and when it reaches 0 restart the layout. also coins that are worth 5 should be 1.5x the size of the others so you can tell them apart. the project folder is <project> , its all in eventSheets/Game.json i think
evals.expected_output: eventSheets/Game.json edited by hand: a countdown variable that loses one per second, ScoreText showing score and time, a restart at 0, coins of value 5 made 1.5 times larger, and a project the checker passes.
assertions: check_project.py of the clone exits 0 on the edited project
check_project.py prints no warning
The countdown loses one per second: it is subtracted under Every X seconds with 1, or by dt every tick
An event restarts the layout under a condition that reads the countdown variable
Every action that sets ScoreText's text after the start writes both the score and the time
An action on Coin makes the coins of value 5 larger: a size or scale action that reads value
Every event of the original sheet is still in it, by sid

evals.name: fix-load-errors
evals.prompt: Construct 3 won't open my project any more. First it said "cannot add another trigger to event branch", I clicked OK and the project just didn't load. Folder: <project> . Another AI edited eventSheets/Game.json yesterday so there may be more than one thing wrong. Please fix it so it opens. The coin should still shrink away and the score should still go up when a coin is collected.
evals.expected_output: All five seeded mistakes repaired, not only the one the editor named, with the collect tween and the score kept, and a project the checker passes.
assertions: check_project.py of the clone exits 0 on the edited project
On start of layout is no longer inverted
On touched's type is the bare combo value start
The tween action carries behaviorType Tween
No trigger is left inside the custom action Collect
ScoreText's action id is set-text
AddScore is still called when a coin is collected: from Collect, or from an event the collect tween's end triggers
Collect still tweens the coin with the tag collect

evals.name: name-the-restart-event
evals.prompt: In the project at <project> , which event restarts the game, and what exactly has to be true for it to fire? Give me the event number as the Construct editor shows it in the event sheet margin, so I can find it.
evals.expected_output: Event 9, the number in the editor's margin: Coin.Count = 0 with Trigger once, then a 1 second wait and Restart layout. The project is left unchanged.
assertions: The answer gives 9 as the event that restarts the layout, and another number only for the group it sits in
The answer states both conditions, Coin.Count = 0 and Trigger once, and the 1 second wait
No project file differs from the fixture

evals.name: find-in-a-long-sheet
evals.prompt: this is the abductractor example from construct, folder <project> . what happens when a tractor gets to the finish line, and where does the game actually restart after that? give me the event numbers like the editor shows them in the margin so i can find them, the sheet is huge
evals.expected_output: Event 103, On collision with FinishLine in the group Finish Line (102), calls prepareForGameOver; its sub-events 104 and 105 call showGameOver with success when the tractor is the player's and with fail otherwise; the function showGameOver, event 108, shows the text, waits 4 seconds and restarts the layout. The sheet prints 38 000 characters and these events are its last, so the answer needs the end of it. The project is left unchanged.
assertions: The answer gives 103 as the event where a tractor collides with the finish line
The answer gives 108, the function showGameOver, as the place where the layout restarts
The answer tells the player's tractor, a success, from any other, a fail
Every event number the answer gives lies between 102 and 108
No project file differs from the fixture

evals.name: lay-out-the-hud
evals.prompt: my coins game is at <project> . its generated by tools/build_project.py so change the generator and rerun it, dont hand edit the json. i want a proper hud: a timer text in the top right corner ("Time: 30", same style as the score), a pause button in the bottom right corner that you tap (a plain sprite is fine, it just has to be there and be tappable, no pause logic yet), and a lives display top center showing 3 hearts (one heart sprite placed 3 times or one wide sprite, up to you). make it tidy and lined up. the score text stays where it is.
evals.expected_output: tools/build_project.py extended and rerun: a timer text, a pause button and a lives display on the UI layer, every one held against its edge or centred, sizes in whole grid units, the button a finger wide, and layouts/Game.json exactly what the generator writes.
assertions: check_project.py of the clone exits 0 on the regenerated project
The UI layer of the Game layout holds at least three instances besides ScoreText, of at least two types: the timer text, the pause button, the lives
Every instance on the UI layer has whole-number x, y, width and height
Every instance on the UI layer has a width and a height in multiples of the 32 px grid unit of the 720x1280 viewport

Every type on the UI layer is held against the viewport: its box has a left or right edge 32 px inside the viewport's, or is centred, and a top or bottom edge 32 px inside, or is centred, or its top one unit under another type's box that is held to the top or bottom
Every box on the UI layer lies inside the viewport
No two boxes on the UI layer overlap: a row of hearts is spaced by its width or more, the timer text does not reach into the score text
The pause button is at least 96 px wide and high, a finger at this viewport
The lives are sprites: three instances of one Sprite type, or one Sprite at least three times as wide as high; a text saying Lives does not count
tools/build_project.py is the source: rerun in a copy, it writes the same layouts/Game.json
